passages.quote: JSP 769 directs efforts to prevent and address sexual exploitation or abuse by Service personnel and Civilian employees acting on behalf of Defence, and outlines appropriate assistance and redress that is available to victims. It includes a prohibition on transactional sex at all times when conducting Defence activity outside of the UK.
